headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: RUS (8)

summary: Charles Leclerc won the Italian Grand Prix from P4 on the grid, 2.7s ahead of Oscar Piastri, with Lando Norris completing the podium.
Franco Colapinto made the biggest climb, from P18 to P12.
Nico Hulkenberg had a day to forget, dropping from P10 to P17.
The stewards penalised RIC (5 second time penalty), HUL (10 second time penalty), RIC (10 second time penalty) and MAG (10 second time penalty).
There were 30 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 62 points over Lando Norris.
